verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs say you can "watch spend in real time" on issued cards and that receipts and categories are captured "as soon as you swipe." They also describe real-time visibility into per-vendor SaaS spend. Ramp's MCP and AI-agent surfaces let you search transactions by merchant, load departments and accounting categories, and ask for top vendors by spend, and pricing lists custom AI reports. Missing for 10: no explicit native dashboard showing spend broken down by team, category, and merchant (these slices are mostly implied via MCP or AI reporting), and no independent or hands-on corroboration of same-day visibility.
